d: I-geon begins uncovering the truth behind the conspiracy. The Queen Dowager launches her revenge, shaking the court, while Doseong confronts the greedy Chief State Councillor.
Myung-yoon is horrified to witness her father poisoning Haejong. I-geon returns to the palace and halts the coronation by presenting the real royal seal.
As Sang-rok attacks I-geon, Myung-yoon shields him with her body. Though she wishes to step back, I-geon insists on protecting her as the Queen Dowager prepares to flee.
After witnessing her father's secret affair, Myung-yoon breaks down in guilt before I-geon. He confesses his love and plans to hide her—with Doseong's help.
Conflict erupts between the Queen Dowager and the Queen over dismissed court ladies. Shocked by his mother's confinement, Doseong refuses to see I-geon.
